V.      Profit distribution plan or reserves-to-equity transfer plan during the Reporting Period upon resolution at the Board meeting

        According to the Company’s audited financial report for the year 2025, the parent company’s undistributed profits at the beginning of
        2025 were RMB51,364,222,000, plus the net profit of RMB11,800,955,000 realised by the parent company during the year, deducting the
        cash dividend of RMB4,073,862,000 for 2024 and the interest of RMB2,389,779,000 distributed to holders of other equity instruments in
        2025, the distributable profit of the parent company at the end of the year was RMB56,701,536,000.

        In accordance with the Company Law and the Articles of Association, based on the Company’s total share capital of 13,579,541,500
        shares as of 31 December 2025, a cash dividend of RMB3.00 (tax inclusive) will be distributed for every 10 shares, with a total profit
        distribution of RMB4,073,862,000, accounting for 25.50% of the distributable profit attributable to holders of ordinary shares of the
        listed company in the consolidated statements for the year. After the distribution, the parent company still had undistributed profits of
        RMB52,627,674,000, which were carried forward to the following year. If there is a change in the total share capital of the company before
        the record date for the implementation of the distribution of equity, it is proposed that the total distribution amount remain unchanged and
        the distribution ratio per share be adjusted accordingly.

      Section II Company Profile and
      Key Financial Indicators

       Solely established by China Railway Construction Corporation (中國鐵道建築總公司) (renamed as China
       Railway Construction Corporation (中國鐵道建築集團有限公司) after being restructured) in Beijing on 5
       November 2007. The Company successfully issued RMB denominated domestic shares (A shares) and
       overseas listed foreign shares (H shares), which were listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the
       Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 10 March 2008 and 13 March 2008, respectively.

       As one of the most powerful and largest comprehensive construction groups in the world, the Company
       was listed among the Fortune “Global 500” for 20 years in a row, ranking No. 51 in 2025.

       The business of the Company comprises construction operation, planning, design and consultancy,
       investment operation, real estate development, manufacturing, materials and logistics, environmental
       protection, industrial finance and other emerging industries, and its operating scope covers 150 countries
       and regions in the world. As a globally renowned construction contractor, infrastructure operator, high-
       end equipment manufacturer, and developer of strategic emerging industries, the Company has a refined
       industry chain covering scientific research, planning, survey, design, construction, supervision and
       management, operation, maintenance, and investment and financing, and has the capability to provide
       one-stop integrated services. The Company has established its industry leadership in fields of engineering
       design and construction for plateau railways, high-speed railways, expressways, bridges, tunnels and
       urban rail transits.

       The Company has two members of Chinese Academy of Engineering, 10 National Survey and Design
       Masters, 11 national candidates of the “Bai Qian Wan Talents Project (百千萬人才工程)” and 310 experts
       who are recipients of special subsidies granted by the State Council.

       The Company has cumulatively received 90 National Prizes for Science and Technology, 167 Zhan
       Tianyou Civil Engineering Awards, 593 National High-Quality Projects Awards (including 52 Gold Awards),
       184 Luban Prizes for China Construction and 6,499 engineering methods above provincial level. The
       Company cumulatively holds 43,536 valid patents.

       The Company continues to strengthen its core functions and enhance its core competitiveness,
       accelerating the transformation and upgrade towards “high-end, intelligent, green, refined, digital, and
       international development”, and steadily advancing towards its vision of becoming a world-class modern
       enterprise.

       Section III                      Chairman’ s Statement

        Dear Shareholders,

        I’m hereby presenting the 2025 annual report of CRCC to you, and expressing the sincere thanks to the
        friends in all walks of life who support and care for the reform and development of the Company for a long
        time!

        Facing the complex and severe market situation and the arduous and heavy tasks of reform and
        development in 2025, CRCC adhered to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese
        Characteristics for a New Era, resolutely implemented the decisions and arrangements of the Central
        Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, as well as the work requirements of the
        State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, upheld high-quality
        development, achieved positive results in all aspects of its work, and successfully concluded the 14th
        Five-Year Plan period.

        In 2025, CRCC strengthened its operation and management, achieving continuous improvement in
        development quality and efficiency. Market operations maintained steady growth with improved quality,
        with the total value of newly signed contracts reaching RMB3,076,497,000,000 for the whole year, fulfilling
        100.5% of the annual plan. Production and operation remained stable and efficient, with operating
        revenue reaching RMB1,029,784,500,000 for the year, total profit reaching RMB26,933,000,000. The
        “Comprehensive Enhancement Year” initiative for refined management was carried out, continuously
        strengthening cost control capabilities and enhancing supply chain management as well as asset
        revitalization and disposal. The Company strictly implemented the requirement of “living a tight life”, firmly
        establishing the principle that “all costs are controllable and reducible”. Dual controls were applied to
        per-capita expenditure standards and total expenditure, with every effort made to reduce non-productive
        expenditures. Selling expenses and administrative expenses exceeded the annual cost-reduction targets.

        In 2025, the Company accelerated transformation and upgrading, achieving multiple breakthroughs in
        consolidating fundamentals and fostering new growth areas. Guided by the “1256” medium- to long-
        term development strategy, the Company has advanced the revitalization of traditional industries and
        the expansion of strategic emerging industries in an integrated manner, accelerating the cultivation of
        new quality productive forces. The Company vigorously promoted the intelligent and green construction
        of traditional industries, accelerating the transformation of production methods. In addition, it vigorously
        promoted penetrating and intensive management, accelerating the transformation of management models.
        The construction of “Digital CRCC” gained momentum, the project cluster management model continued
        to be promoted, and production efficiency and management efficiency steadily improved. The Company
        further refined and clarified the key areas of strategic emerging industries and the responsibilities of
        leading units in specific segments, improved the “four-layer screening mechanism”, implemented the
        “five clarifications (五 定)” penetrating management, established a strategic emerging industry fund,
        accelerated the implementation of strategic emerging projects, and continuously increased the proportion
        of contribution from strategic emerging industries.

        In 2025, CRCC strengthened technological innovation, accelerating its development pace. The Company
        completed the restructuring of the “1+9+N” technological innovation system, established the General
        Academy of Science and Technology Research, and set up seven industrial technology research institutes
        focusing on green and low-carbon development, underground space, high-end equipment, new materials,
        new energy, bamboo-based industries, and marine economy, along with 23 open collaborative R&D
        platforms. New materials and equipment developed independently or through collaboration continued
        to emerge. CRCC made solid progress in implementing the special initiative “Qihang Action”. Annual
        tasks for the original technology source for underground space in future industries advanced smoothly,
        breakthroughs in key and core technologies progressed steadily, and scientific and technological
        innovation achievements were abundant, further consolidating the Company’s technological advantages.
        A total of 6,732 new authorized patents were obtained, including 2,990 invention patents, ranking at the
        A-level in the patent rankings of central state-owned enterprises, and successfully obtained approval as
        one of the first batch of national-level industrial intellectual property operation centers.
                                                                                                              13




                         Section III Chairman’ s Statement (continued)


In 2025, CRCC continued to deepen reforms, continuously stimulating its internal momentum. The
Company has improved modern enterprise systems with Chinese characteristics, integrating Party
leadership into all aspects of corporate governance. The Company implemented the special initiative
of “simplify organizational structures and optimize staffing”, further reinforcing the talent selection and
appointment principle of “appointments based on competition and promotions based on performance”.
The Company refined the compensation management system, promoting standardized and refined salary
distribution. With systematical reconstruction of performance evaluation system, further improvement
and implementation of evaluation requirements such as “one enterprise, one policy”, “one position, one
policy”, and “individual contracts, personal accounts, and individual targets assigned for everyone”,
the application of results and rigorous enforcement were strengthened, ensuring that the performance
evaluation functions effectively as a “guiding tool”.

2026 marks the beginning of the 15th Five-Year Plan period and is a crucial year for CRCC to accelerate
transformation and upgrading, comprehensively enhance quality and efficiency, and pursue high-
quality and innovative development. In the face of new circumstances, changes, and challenges, CRCC
will adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while maintaining stability, accelerate the
consolidation and upgrading of its foundation, foster innovation and cultivate new growth drivers, enhance
quality and efficiency, uphold high-quality development, steadily improve efficiency and profitability,
continuously strengthen core functions, and enhance core competitiveness. CRCC will spare no effort to
ensure a successful start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

First, we will focus on stabilizing growth momentum and expanding space for high-quality development.
By coordinating the operations of traditional and emerging industries as well as domestic and overseas
markets, CRCC aims to consolidate the fundamental market base, seize window opportunities, accelerate
the development of strategic emerging industries, broaden international business channels, and achieve
long-term sustainable overseas growth.

Second, we will focus on improving efficiency and profitability to solidify the foundation for high-quality
development. With the refined management as a key approach, CRCC will tap into the potential for cost
reduction and efficiency enhancement. With a focus on supply chain management, it will lower production
factor costs. Relying on digital transformation, CRCC will enhance production and management efficiency.

Third, we will focus on deepen reform and innovation, and develop new-quality productivity in a
manner tailored to local conditions. CRCC will accelerate the establishment of a new type of production
relations that aligns with the development of new quality productive forces, and expedite the integrated
development of technological innovation and industrial innovation, providing strong support for the
Company’s strategic transformation.

Fourth, we will focus on preventing and defusing risks, and better balance development and security.
Adhering to a systemic approach, CRCC will hold firm to the bottom line of risk, enhance our capacity to
prevent and defuse risks and challenges, and contribute to overall stability through its own stability.

CRCC will rally even more closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core,
adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era,
fully implement the new development philosophy, and strengthen confidence and unite in forging ahead.
We will strive to write a new chapter in the Company’s high-quality development, deliver excellent results
to give back to society, reward shareholders, and benefit employees, and make new and significant
contributions to advancing the modernization of China.

        I.      OPERATIONS OF THE COMPANY DURING THE REPORTING PERIOD

                CRCC is one of the most powerful and largest ultra-large comprehensive construction groups in
                the world. The business of the Company comprises construction operation, planning, design and
                consultancy, investment operation, real estate development, manufacturing, materials and logistics,
                environmental protection, industrial finance and other emerging industries.

                (I)    Construction operations

                       Construction operations are the core and traditional business of the Group, which cover
                       multiple fields, such as railways, highways, rail transit, water conservancy and hydropower,
                       housing construction, municipal engineering, bridges, tunnels, airports and wharves. In
                       2025, the Group adhered unwaveringly to high-quality development, achieving effective
                       improvement in the “quality” of production and operation. The “fundamental base” of the
                       traditional market remained generally stable, with newly signed railway contracts reaching
                       the best performance since the “14th Five-Year Plan” period, significantly increasing market
                       share in the national railway sector, and newly signed highway contracts growing against the
                       trend.

                (II)   Planning, design and consultancy

                       Planning, design, and consultancy operations of the Group mainly comprise four large Grade
                       II institutes with comprehensive Grade-A engineering design qualifications and 24 tertiary
                       and lower-level specialized design institutes (excluding subsidiaries and branches of the
                       four large Grade II institutes)and cover fields including railways, urban rail transit, highways,
                       municipal works, and industrial and civil buildings, keeping expanding into new industries
                       such as intelligent transportation, modern trams, urban utility tunnels, urban underground
                       space, ecological environment, and environmental protection. In 2025, the planning, design,
                       and consulting business actively embraced digital transformation, leveraging the “1+9+N”
                       technological innovation system to vigorously advance digital and intelligent transformation.
                       Efficiency of the entire design process of the railway survey and design information and
                       intelligent platform was significantly improved, and it was successfully included in the
                       first pilot program for follow-on investment in innovation areas by the State-owned Assets
                       Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council.

(III)   Investment operation

        The Group actively deploys strategic emerging industries such as new infrastructure, new
        equipment, new materials, new energy, and new services, accelerating the enhancement
        of multi-format integrated development and asset operation capabilities, and effectively
        leveraging investment to drive corporate transformation and upgrading, structural
        adjustment, and profit growth. In 2025, the Group adhered to shifting from investment-driven
        construction back to the original purpose of investment for creating returns. Focusing on the
        theme of high-quality development and following a strategy that balances light and heavy
        assets with short and long-term investments, the Company optimized its investment structure
        and achieved healthy and sustainable growth in its investment operations. The Group
        established a strategic emerging industry fund to promote the implementation of strategic
        emerging investment projects, initially forming a tiered development pattern of “one batch for
        store, one batch for advancement, and one batch for implementation”.

(IV)    Real estate development

        As one of the 16 enterprises directly under the central government taking real estate
        development as principal business as confirmed by the SASAC, the Group adheres to
        the principle of convergence and focus in its business layout, deeply conducting and
        expanding projects in key cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Xi’an,
        Hefei, and Hangzhou. The Group adopts the business model of “giving priority to residential
        development, supplemented by other industries” for real estate business. It actively
        participated in the development and construction of government-subsidised housing and
        buyback housing. In 2025, the Group focused on strengthening marketing and inventory
        reduction efforts. In terms of investment, the Group further strengthened risk control,
        implemented precise investments, and prudently and steadily accumulated high-quality land
        reserves.

(V)     Manufacturing

        The Group is a leading domestic and internationally advanced provider of materials and
        professional equipment manufacturing services integrating R&D, manufacturing, sales
        and services. After years of development, manufacturing operations cultivate three main
        businesses: equipment manufacturing, material production and precast concrete production.
        The business scope covers the manufacture of large railway track maintenance machinery,
        underground construction equipment, rail construction equipment, concrete construction
        equipment, lifting equipment, bridge construction equipment, compacting equipment,
        concrete products, bridge steel structures, turnout and spring bar fastener, and electric
        contact wire and parts. Leveraging its whole chain advantage, the Group actively promotes
        operating synergy and industry synergy and builds an integrated operation mode that
        incorporates multiple industries, so as to improve the competitiveness of the Company and
        the brand influence, and enhance overall profitability. In the meantime, it improves the weak
        links, and vigorously develops emerging businesses like new energy equipment, high-
        speed railroad maintenance equipment, high-end smart agricultural machinery, plateau
        space station, and new materials and the business of equipment maintenance, leasing and
        remanufacturing, to foster the “second growth curve.” In 2025, the industrial manufacturing
        sector accelerated the cultivation of new quality productive forces, vigorously promoted
        intelligent and green manufacturing, and built a “2+4+7" lighthouse factory with China
        Railway Construction characteristics. The Group’s subsidiary, CRCHI, was successfully
        selected as a 2025 Excellence-level Smart Factory by the Ministry of Industry and Information
        Technology.

                (VI)    Materials and logistics

                        The Group takes materials and logistics as an important business to support its main

                        construction, and operation, In terms of business model, the Group primarily generates

                        sewage treatment. As an important component of strategic emerging industries, the green

                        environmental protection industry is gradually becoming a new and significant growth driver
                        for the Company.

II.   INDUSTRY SITUATION OF THE COMPANY DURING THE REPORTING PERIOD

      (I)   Construction operations

            In 2025, the value added of the construction industry in China accounted to RMB8,642,500
            million, representing a decrease of 1.1% compared to the previous year. The total profit
            of general and specialized contracting construction enterprises with qualification grades
            was RMB635,500 million, a decrease of 14.1% compared to the previous year, indicating a
            continued contraction trend in construction operations. Significant differentiation emerged
            in traditional segments. Fixed-asset investment in areas such as highways, municipal works,
            and housing construction declined, while emerging markets like power engineering and
            mining engineering achieved leapfrog development. Faced with downward pressure in the
            industry, enterprises engaging in construction operations accelerated the transformation of
            their development models, promoted intelligent and green construction and strengthened
            whole-process refined management, leading to a further increase in industry concentration.

(IV)   Real estate development

       In 2025, the real estate development investment in China amounted to RMB8,278,800
       million, representing a decrease of 17.2% compared to the previous year, of which, the
       residential investment totaled RMB6,351,400 million, representing a decrease of 16.3%
       year-on-year; the floor area of newly built commercial housing sold reached 881.01 million
       square meters. The real estate market shown marginal improvement under the continuous
       efforts of policies, but the recovery on the demand side still faced challenges, and the
       overall market was in the bottoming out stage. In 2025, the term “Quality Housing” was
       included in the Report on the Work of the Government for the first time, clearly defining the
       development of safe, comfortable, green and smart “Quality Housing” as the core direction
       of the industry transformation. The national standard Residential Project Specifications was
       formally implemented on 1 May 2025, providing institutional guarantee for the upgrading of
       residential quality. The State continued to advance urban renewal initiatives, with 27,000 old
       urban residential communities starting renovation throughout the year, benefiting 4.99 million
       households. Against this backdrop, real estate developers have focused on deepening their
       presence and expansion in core cities, strengthened marketing and inventory destocking
       efforts, actively participated in the construction of indemnificatory housing, renovation of
       dilapidated and old housing and other related projects, devoted efforts to promoting refined
       project management, increased product innovation in such fields as green buildings and
       smart communities, and continuously improved the quality of development.

(V)    Manufacturing

       In 2025, six departments including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
       jointly issued the “Work Plan for Stabilizing Growth in the Machinery Industry (2025–2026)”,
       proposing to cultivate a group of competitive specialized industrial clusters for small
       and medium-sized enterprises and internationally competitive industrial clusters, and to
       foster several world-class enterprises in fields such as construction machinery and rail
       transit equipment. The traditional general engineering machinery industry was affected by
       overcapacity, and the market competition intensified, indicating that industry concentration
       may be further on the rise. Concurrently, the state is vigorously promoting the development of
       intelligent manufacturing, implementing innovation projects for smart equipment, enhancing
       the research and development of general-purpose large models and industry-specific large
       models for the machinery sector, and fostering the integration and innovation of emerging
       technologies such as artificial intelligence and quantum technology with equipment. The
       supply capacity of core equipment in the high-end equipment manufacturing industry has
       steadily improved, providing new directions for the transformation and upgrading of the
       industrial manufacturing sector.

(VI)   Materials and logistics

       In 2025, the total value of social logistics nationwide reached RMB368,200,000 million,
       representing a year-on-year increase of 5.1%. The ratio of total social logistics costs to
       GDP decreased to 13.9%, a decline of 0.2 percentage points compared to 2024, effectively
       consolidating the achievements in reducing overall social logistics costs. The total logistics
       volume of industrial products increased by 5.3% year-on-year, with logistics demand in
       the equipment manufacturing and high-tech manufacturing sectors both growing by over
       9%. The logistics volume for industrial robots rose by 28% year-on-year, while that for new
       energy vehicles increased by 25.1% year-on-year. With the application and promotion
       of technologies such as big data, cloud platforms, and the Internet of Things in relevant
       fields, the transparency of centralized procurement of materials has improved, operational
       efficiency in logistics and transportation has increased, and supply chain management has
       achieved qualitative breakthroughs. The material logistics industry is currently in a critical
       period of technological innovation and digital transformation.

(I)   Strengthening high-quality operations, with production and business performance
      remaining stable and improving.

      Adhere unswervingly to high-quality development, and achieve effective improvement in
      the “quality” and reasonable growth in the “quantity” of production and operation. First, the
      market operations achieved steady progress with quality enhancement. The Group closely
      aligned with the central and local government measures to stabilize growth, emphasized
      strategic orientation and key performance indicator assessments, strengthened lawful and
      compliant operations, continuously improved independent operational capabilities, and
      further enhanced the “value-added” content of our contracts. The total value of newly signed
      contracts for the year was RMB3,076,497.0 million, achieving 100.50% of the annual target.
      The “fundamental base” of the traditional market remained generally stable. The newly
      signed contract value for railways was RMB311,622.6 million, representing an increase of
      16.19% year-on-year; the newly signed contract value for highways was RMB224,739.1
      million, achieving a counter-trend increase of 15.92%. The emerging markets achieved
      leapfrog development. The newly signed contract value for mining engineering was
      RMB226,477.2 million, representing an increase of 17.34% year-on-year; the newly signed
      contract value for power engineering exceeded RMB208,968.4 million, representing an
      increase of 18.21% year-on-year. International operations achieved significant results, with
      new overseas contract value reaching RMB363,339.8 million, representing an increase of
      16.46% year-on-year. The proportion of overseas business rose to 11.81%, hitting a new
      high once again. Second, production and operations maintained stable and efficient output.
      The Company achieved operating revenue of RMB1,029,784,500,000 for the whole year.
      Of this total, overseas operating revenue amounted to RMB75,873,500,000, representing a
      year-on-year increase of 15.14% and an increase of 1.19 percentage points in its proportion.
      Comprehensive efforts were made to strengthen production scheduling and supervision of
      key and challenging projects, with responsibilities for stable and full-capacity production
      reinforced at every level. Credit evaluation management, both internal and external, was
      enhanced. The “Guidance on Internal Credit Evaluation for Construction Enterprises” was
      issued, and six subsidiaries ranked among the top ten in railway credit evaluations. The
      safety and quality control was continuously enhanced. The Group implemented a three-
      year action plan for fundamental improvements in production safety, enforcing safety
      management systems and maintaining a high-pressure approach to accident penalties.
      The Group strengthened comprehensive quality management and energy conservation
      and environmental protection efforts, winning 28 National Quality and Technology Awards
      and 77 Railway Excellence in Engineering (Survey and Design) Awards, with the number of
      awards remaining among the highest in the industry. Several landmark projects constructed
      by the Group, including the Dongjin Yellow River Bridge, Beijing East Sixth Ring Road
      Reconstruction Project, Baotou-Yinchuan High-Speed Railway, and Serbia Section of the
      Hungary-Serbia Railway, were opened to traffic, while the entire Western Railway Mineral
      Line in Algeria was fully laid. China Railway Construction, a subsidiary of the Group,
      participated in the construction of the Boao Zero-Carbon Demonstration Zone, the nation’s
      first zero-carbon demonstration area, which was selected as one of the top ten super
      projects of central state-owned enterprises.

                       for Intelligent Design of Land Transportation Infrastructure” received high marks in the

                       the “Set Sail” action, smoothly advancing the annual tasks of the original technology source
                       initiative. We accelerated the implementation of 34 special underground space projects of
                       CRCC, promoted research topics, demonstration projects, and typical scenario development
                       in the underground space field, and completed three major landmark achievements. The
                       “Steel Backbone” shaft boring machine independently developed by CRCHI was selected
                       as one of the top ten national heavy equipment of central enterprises in 2025. The Intelligent
                       Transportation Technology Company of the 15th Bureau Group and the Bamboo Winding
                       Development Company of the 18th Bureau Group were included in the list of “Set Sail”
                       enterprises by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the
                       State Council. Third, the Group has achieved fruitful results in scientific and technological
                       innovation and continuously consolidated its technological advantages. A total of 6,732 new
                       authorized patents were obtained, including 2,990 invention patents, with the proportion of
                       invention patents reaching 44.41%. The Group successfully obtained approval as one of
                       the first batch of national-level industrial intellectual property operation centers. The Group
                       achieved new breakthroughs in scientific and technological awards, winning 1 gold award,
                       1 silver award, and 4 excellence awards at the 25th China Patent Awards; and 5 awards
                       including the Special Invention Award and Gold Award at the 50th Geneva International
                       Exhibition of Inventions. It has won six international awards, including those from the
                       International Tunneling Association and the International Bridge Conference. The Group
                       jointly led the release of four ISO/IEC international standards, and participated as lead or
                       contributing editor in the formulation of 83 national standards and 34 industry standards.
                       In addition, CRCC International promoted the conversion of CRCC standard “Technical
                       Specification for Bridge Rotation Construction” into a regional standard in Hong Kong.

(V)   Continuous deepening of reform and ongoing stimulation of endogenous momentum.

      Took tough and decisive measures to advance reform, and the campaign to deepen
      and upgrade the reform of state-owned enterprises was successfully completed. First,
      the governance system continued to be improved. The Company has improved modern
      enterprise systems with Chinese characteristics, integrating Party leadership into all
      aspects of corporate governance. It completed the reform of the board of supervisors and
      revised and improved 26 governance systems, including the “Articles of Association”. The
      Group convened a work conference on advancing the development of subsidiary boards
      of directors, selected qualified professionals to strengthen the pool of external directors,
      and enhanced the performance management of external directors. The Board’s role in
      “setting strategy, making decisions, and preventing risks,” as well as its oversight function,
      was further strengthened. Second, the Group has simplified organizational structures
      and continuously optimized the personnel selection and appointment mechanism. The
      Group continued to advance the reform of headquarters at all levels, implemented market-
      oriented and competitive talent selection methods such as open recruitment and competitive
      appointment, further solidified the personnel selection and appointment orientation of
      “appointment based on competition and promotion based on performance”, and further
      intensified the cultivation of young cadres. Third, the compensation distribution system has
      become more standardized and reasonable. The Group established a decision-making
      mechanism centered on “linking wages with performance”, promoting the standardization
      and refinement of compensation distribution. The Group differentiated the standards
      for basic annual salary, performance annual salary, and tenure incentives for heads
      of subsidiary enterprises, achieving “salary increases with performance improvement
      and decreases with performance decline”. Fourth, the assessment system has been
      systematically reshaped. Adhering to the medium- to long-term development strategy of
      “1256", the Group has improved and refined the performance assessment indicator library
      for subsidiary enterprises, strengthened the assessment of strategic guiding indicators,
      and achieved a closed loop of “strategy-execution-assessment”. The Group continued to
      deepen the implementation of the “one enterprise, one policy”, “one position, one policy”,
      and “each person with a contract, each with an account, each bearing indicators” assessment
      requirements, strengthened the application of results and rigid fulfillment, effectively
      leveraging the “baton” role of assessment. The Group actively promoted the term-based
      and contract-based management of the managerial level. The Group continuously improved
      the economic responsibility assessment system for projects, encouraged the sharing of
      excess profits, and fully mobilized the enthusiasm and creativity of frontline employees.
      Significant achievements were made in the cultivation of high-end talents. Mr. Xiao Mingqing
      was successfully elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. One
      person was recognized as an outstanding scientific and technological leading talent among
      central enterprises, two were recognized as leading talents among central enterprises, and
      five were selected as experts directly contacted by the Party Committee of the State-owned
      Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council.

                (II)   Complete and comprehensive industrial chain layout

                       As one of the world’s most comprehensive and capable integrated construction industry
                       groups, the Group boasts a complete industrial chain covering the upstream and downstream
                       of the construction industry. For owners in different fields, of different types, and with various
                       needs, we are capable of providing complete-process, full-cycle, personalised, tailored, and
                       high-quality services in terms of construction operation, planning, design and consultancy,
                       investment operation, real estate development, manufacturing, materials and logistics,
                       environmental protection, industrial finance, and emerging industries. In 2025, the Group
                       further refined its responsibilities and improved its mechanisms, resulting in a significant
                       increase in the contribution of strategic emerging industries and new breakthroughs in the
                       development of overseas strategic emerging industries. The Group business operations span
                       across the country and 150 countries and regions in the world, forming long-term stable

                       enterprises.

(III)   Continuous improvement of refined management

        Refined management is considered an important indicator of the enterprise’s competitiveness
        at the Group. It has established a comprehensive refined management system covering
        all systems, all links, all positions, and all fields, promoting enterprise development
        transformations in quality, efficiency, and driving force. Adhering to cost management as the
        core, the Group firmly upheld the fundamental principle that “all costs are controllable and
        reducible”. By implementing the background management responsibilities of corporate legal
        persons for projects and the front-line management responsibilities of project departments,
        the Group promoted the achievement of high-quality projects, excellent benefits, and
        outstanding cadres, thereby enhancing its core competitiveness. It has established
        and improved a target responsibility system, work standard system, and assessment
        and evaluation system that match the comprehensive refined management, driving the
        modernisation of its management system and capabilities.

(IV)    Continuous enhancement of brand influence

        The Group is a globally renowned construction operation contractor, infrastructure operator,
        high-end equipment manufacturer, and emerging industry developer. Its business scope
        covers 150 countries and regions worldwide. It has constructed 50% of China’s conventional
        and high-speed railways, 40% of urban rail transit, and 30% of high-grade railways. It has
        fully participated in various investment operation businesses in expressways, urban rail
        transit, railways, and industrial parks, and has retained its international credit ratings of
        Moody’s A3, Standard & Poor’s A1 and China Chengxin AAA. It owns the world’s largest
        underground engineering equipment manufacturing base, achieving tailored R&D and
        intelligent manufacturing of full series of tunnel boring machines with diameters ranging from
        0.5 meters to 23 meters. It independently developed the world’s largest-diameter, heaviest
        single-unit, and highest-load-bearing integral shield machine main bearing. It has been
        consecutively listed among Fortune magazine’s “Global 500", ranking No. 51 in 2025. In
        2025, it ranked 6th in the global engineering brand value ranking, with its corporate brand
        value continuously increasing.

(V)     Continuous enhancement of cultural cohesion

        The Group inherits and promotes the spirit of the Railway Soldiers, enriches and improves
        the “First Ten Spirits of CRCC”, strengthens cultural story creation and dissemination, forming
        the deepest and most enduring spiritual force. This inspires and encourages all employees to
        advance the enterprise’s high-quality development and achieve tangible results in promoting
        the cultural development of CRCC in the new era. Adhering to the management philosophy
        of “people-oriented, trustworthy and law-abiding, being in harmony with nature, and building
        high-quality products”, the Company has deepened its expertise in the domestic and
        international construction and related industries. It has established the corporate values of
        “eternal integrity and innovation, equal emphasis on quality and integrity”, and is striding
        forward to become a world-class modern enterprise.

 The change in finance costs was mainly due to: the increase in interest expenses

 The change in research and development expenses was mainly due to: the Company’s

 The change in impairment losses on assets was mainly due to: the provision for losses

 The change in impairment of credit losses was mainly due to: the provision for losses
 recognised on financial assets such as receivables during the reporting period.

 The change in net cash flows generated from operating activities was mainly due to:
 the decrease in cash paid for goods and services during the reporting period.

 The change in net cash flows generated from investing activities was mainly due to:

 The change in net cash flows generated from financing activities was mainly due to:

 period compared to the same period last year.

3.    Expenses

       ✓ Applicable           Not Applicable

      In 2025, the Group’s selling and distribution expenses amounted to RMB6.4120 billion,
      a decrease of 6.20% compared to 2024. The decrease in selling and distribution
      expenses was primarily due to cost control measures implemented during the
      reporting period.

      In 2025, the Group’s administrative expenses amounted to RMB20.1383 billion, a
      decrease of 9.81% compared to 2024. The decrease in administrative expenses was
      mainly attributable to cost control initiatives during the reporting period.

      In 2025, the Group’s research and development expenses amounted to RMB23.5960
      billion, a decrease of 8.23% compared to 2024. The decrease in R&D expenses was
      primarily due to the Company’s optimization of its R&D spending structure, coupled
      with the phased reduction of investment in selected projects.

      In 2025, the Group’s finance costs amounted to RMB10.9716 billion, an increase of
      38.07% compared to 2024. The increase in finance costs was mainly attributable to
      the year-on-year increase in interest expenses.

      In 2025, the Group’s income tax expense amounted to RMB5.2461 billion, a decrease
      of 2.78% compared to 2024, primarily due to the decrease in business scale and total
      profit for the year. Details of the income tax expense are set out in the table below.

7.    Defined benefit plan

      Certain employees of the Group are on long-term leave. Post-employment benefits
      are accrued in the relevant entities of the Group during the period in which the Group
      has entered into relevant agreements/documents with the employees or after the
      individual employees have been advised of the specific terms. The specific terms of
      post-employment benefits vary depending on various factors including their positions,
      length of service, and the district in which the employees are located.

      As at 31 December 2024 and 31 December 2025, the Group’s provisions for such
      obligations amounted to RMB0.0693 billion and RMB0.0576 billion, respectively.

                              (5)    Quality control system, standards of implementation, control measures and
                                     overall evaluation of the Company

                                      In 2025, the Company thoroughly implemented the spirit of the “Outline for
                                      Building a Nation with Strong Quality”, consistently prioritized quality work,
                                      closely aligned with the Company’s development strategy, focused on quality
                                      standardization as the core, utilized quality activities as the vehicle, and
                                      emphasized red-line management and defect prevention. The Company
                                      diligently carried out various quality-related tasks. The entire system did not
                                      experience any major or above-grade engineering quality accidents. The
                                      quality management situation remained stable and continued to improve, fully
                                      safeguarding the Company’s high-quality development.

                                      ①          Quality management control system and implementation standards

                                                 The quality management control system of the Company is developed in
                                                 strict accordance with national standards including GB/T 19001–2016/
                                                 ISO 9001:2015 and GB/T 50430–2017. During the Reporting Period, the
                                                 Company passed the supervision review of China Certification Centre
                                                 for certificate renewal. Its management systems and documents met the
                                                 standard requirements, and the management system ran effectively, and
                                                 the management of each process from investment, design, construction
                                                 to operation processes was in line with the “process method” with
                                                 further improvement. The registration and authentication qualification
                                                 of the quality management systems of the Company is continuously
                                                 maintained and the certificate numbers are 02124Q10954R8M and
                                                 U006624Q0243R8M.

     ②   Measures for quality management control

         The first is to strengthen the construction of quality standardization.
         The Group thoroughly implemented the requirements of refined
         management and strengthened the standardization of engineering
         quality management. During the year, it focused on completing the
         compilation of the Quality Standardization Management Manuals for
         Urban Rail Transit and Highway Engineering, further standardizing
         quality management practices and promoting the in-depth advancement
         of quality management.

         The second is to solidly carry out quality activities for all employees.
         The Group organized activities for the 48th National “Quality Month”,
         focusing on the theme “Strengthen Comprehensive Quality Management
         to Promote the Building of a Quality-Oriented Country.” It also organized
         participation in the “National Enterprise Employees’ Comprehensive
         Quality Management Knowledge Competition,” with over 260,000
         participants taking the online quiz. During the event period, the Group
         planned and organized the “Quality CRCC Online Showcase” virtual
         open day, which focused on showcasing cutting-edge technologies and
         quality management achievements, attracting over 5,000 online viewers.
         The Group further advanced the activities of QC groups and quality-
         trustworthy work teams. Throughout the year, the Group received a total
         of 343 national-level QC group activity achievement awards, including
         142 from the China Construction Industry Association, 91 from the China
         Association of Construction Enterprise Management, and 110 from the
         China Railway Construction Association; 104 work teams were awarded
         for their achievements in building quality-trustworthy work teams. It
         actively applied for the National Quality Technology Award. In the 2025
         selection, the Company secured a total of 28 awards (8 second prizes
         and 20 third prizes), setting a new record for the total number of awards
         and continuously enhancing the Company’s quality innovation and
         competitiveness.

         The third is to actively carry out initiatives for excellence in engineering
         quality, striving to create high-quality projects. The Group continued
         to enhance the influence of its quality brand, with 12 projects winning
         the China Construction Engineering Luban Award and 11 projects
         receiving the National Quality Engineering Award during the year. The
         Guangzhou Metro Line 18 and the Qatar Lusail Stadium both won the
         National High-Quality Engineering Gold Award, ranking first among
         construction enterprises nationwide. The Group leveraged the leading
         role of high-quality projects by organizing the selection of the CRCC Cup
         High-Quality Engineering Award. A total of 150 projects were awarded
         the “CRCC Cup” High-Quality Engineering Award this year. The Group
         encouraged innovation in surveying and design and organized the
         evaluation of the “Four Excellence” Awards in Surveying and Design,
         with a total of 171 projects selected as winners. The Group achieved
         remarkable results in railway engineering excellence, winning a total of
         77 Railway Quality Engineering (Survey and Design) Awards in the 2023–
         2024 evaluation, ranking first among all participating companies.
62   China Railway Construction Corporation Limited∣Annual Report 2025

                                             The fourth is to strictly manage railway red lines and strengthen the
                                             prevention and control of quality defects. The Group regularly conducted
                                             self-inspections and rectifications under railway red-line management. In
                                             the two special inspections on railway red-line management organized
                                             by China State Railway Group in 2025, its subsidiaries achieved
                                             no significant red-line issues or major adverse behaviors for two

                              (6)     Operation of work safety system of the company

                                      In 2025, the Company centered its efforts on the three-year action plan for
                                      fundamental improvements in production safety, adhering to the principle of
                                      treating both symptoms and root causes with comprehensive measures. It
                                      focused on coordinating the core elements of people, machinery, environment,
                                      and management, and advanced hazard remediation, foundational
                                      strengthening, and efficiency enhancement. The Company strived to build a
                                      “comprehensive safety” framework and accelerate the transition of the safety
                                      governance model toward proactive prevention.

                                      First, the Group systematically established an intrinsic safety system. The
                                      Group compiled the “CRCC Intrinsic Safety Guidance Manual (2025 Edition),”
                                      its first systematic safety framework, to guide all levels in establishing a
                                      structured management system, enforce safety responsibilities across all
                                      personnel, and strengthen comprehensive, end-to-end risk control. The Group
                                      collected and applied typical case studies from the “Intrinsic Safety Guidance
                                      Manual”, developed specialized scenario-based series of pictorial guides, and
                                      compiled and distributed “Safety Production Information” to promote mutual
                                      learning, sharing of best practices, and collective improvement among various
                                      units, thereby advancing the implementation of the manual.
                                                                                           63




 Section IV Management Discussion and Analysis
(Work Report of the Board of Directors) (continued)


     Second, the Group deepened the investigation and rectification of potential
     hazards. The Group standardized the “Four Noes and Two Directs” safety
     supervision and inspection practices, and organized regional safety
     supervision activities. The “Thunderbolt Action” special inspection was carried
     out, emphasizing both system checks and on-site control, comprehensively
     reviewing the effectiveness of the operation of the safety management system,
     and focusing on identifying and eliminating prominent issues and potential
     hazards on-site. Focusing on three key areas: subcontract management, on-
     site management, and the procurement and quality management of important
     auxiliary materials, the “Three Special Rectification” actions were promoted.

     Third, the Group consolidated the foundational construction of safety. The
     Group formulated the “China Railway Construction Major Accident Potential
     Hazard Identification Standards (2025 Edition)”, revised the “Major Accident
     Potential Hazard Identification Standards Atlas” for housing and municipal
     engineering, railway, highway, water conservancy engineering, and special
     equipment fields, guiding technical and management personnel at all levels
     to accurately investigate and manage potential accident hazards. The
     Group issued safety standardization guidance manuals for tunnels, bridges,
     protection, operational line construction, offshore wind power, drilling-and-
     blasting-method tunnel construction, etc., as well as key points for (large-scale)
     equipment safety control, promoting 84 standardized and fixed-form protective
     measures, as well as intelligent safety protective measures, enhancing the
     overall level of on-site safety management.

     Fourth, the Group focused on enhancing management efficiency. The Group
     organized an observation meeting on work permit management (pilot) and the
     2025 work safety training session, comprehensively advancing the pilot program
     for work permit management, establishing a list-based management system
     for hazardous and general operations, and implementing the requirements for
     thorough safety management. The Group promoted the digital transformation
     of work safety and implemented the requirements for thorough supervision. The
     Group advanced the in-depth application of big data and artificial intelligence
     technologies, utilizing intelligent video surveillance systems to identify safety
     hazards in real time, applying AI-powered multimodal large language model
     technology to accurately assess operational risks, and achieving intelligent
     early warning of safety risks and unsafe behaviors. The Group actively
     responded to the national policy on equipment renewal, carried out special
     actions to improve the intrinsic safety of equipment, promoted advanced
     equipment such as intelligent monitoring and automated protection systems,
     and systematically enhanced the intrinsic safety level of equipment. The Group
     promoted the application of industrial robots and intelligent equipment in high-
     risk processes such as tunnels, mines, and underground engineering to reduce
     safety risks.

     Fifth, emergency response capabilities have been significantly enhanced.
     A total of 126 projects, 6,986 full-time and part-time rescue team members,
     and 2,769 sets of equipment were pre-positioned and incorporated into
     the emergency rescue forces of the Ministry of Emergency Management.
     Throughout the year, they participated in 321 emergency rescue and disaster
     relief efforts, including the Dingri earthquake in Tibet and flood relief in Hebei,
     deploying 19,471 person-times and 3,515 sets of equipment. The Group
     jointly conducted multi-format, multi-scenario comprehensive emergency drills
     with the Hebei District Government of Tianjin Municipality, involving over 500
     personnel and covering 6 subjects. The Group organized training courses to
     enhance emergency response capabilities, providing training for personnel in
     safety supervision and emergency rescue positions.

        VI.     DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF THE COMPANY’ S FUTURE DEVELOPMENT

                (I)    Industry pattern and trends

                        ✓ Applicable              Not Applicable

                       From the international, domestic and industry perspectives, the Group will face the following
                       opportunities and challenges in its future development.

                       Opportunities: First, opportunities from the international environment. Economic globalization
                       is gaining momentum, China continues to advance high-level opening-up, and the high-
                       quality joint development of the Belt and Road Initiative has created favorable conditions for
                       the Company to expand overseas markets. Second, opportunities from national strategies.
                       China’s economy enjoys long-term sound fundamentals with remarkable advantages in
                       systems, market, industrial system and human resources, providing a solid foundation for the
                       high-quality development of the Company. Third, opportunities from industry development.
                       The overseas construction market boasts broad space, domestic segmented sectors such
                       as water conservancy, electric power and mining maintain growth, and emerging markets
                       including new infrastructure, urban renewal and new-type urbanization enjoy huge potential,
                       bringing new space and potential for industry development. Fourth, opportunities empowered
                       by technology. The new round of scientific and technological revolution is making
                       accelerating breakthroughs, and technological innovations in 6G, artificial intelligence, digital
                       twin, new energy and other fields have brought new opportunities for the transformation and
                       upgrading of the construction industry. Fifth, opportunities from SOE reform. The deepening
                       of state-owned assets and SOE reform continues to advance, and the core functions and
                       core competitiveness of state-owned enterprises are constantly enhanced, injecting new
                       impetus into the development of the Company.

                       Challenges: First, challenges from the international environment. The global landscape is
                       undergoing profound adjustment, geopolitical risks are on the rise, trade protectionism is
                       resurging, and the external environment is becoming more complex, severe and uncertain,
                       posing challenges to the Company’s international operations. Second, challenges from high-
                       quality development. Unbalanced and inadequate domestic development remains, effective
                       demand is insufficient, competition in the traditional construction industry is intensifying, and
                       the Company’s capital pressure has increased somewhat. Third, challenges from growth
                       momentum transformation. Economic development is shifting toward new quality productive
                       forces, and technological innovation and industrial upgrading have put forward higher
                       requirements for the Company’s technological reserves, talent training and management
                       model. Fourth, challenges from corporate management and control capabilities. Pressure
                       from the external industry situation and internal transformation and upgrading has posed
                       great challenges to corporate management and risk prevention and control.

(II)     Development strategies of the Company

          ✓ Applicable           Not Applicable

         The Company formulated its Medium- and Long-Term Development Strategy, establishing a
         medium- and long-term development strategy system with the “1256" strategic framework as
         the core. The Group adheres to carrying out all work in accordance with the “1256" medium-
         to long-term development strategy.

         Based on the “two overall situations” (the overall domestic and international situations) and
         guided by the “National Priorities”, the Company will fully, accurately, and comprehensively
         implement the new development philosophy, actively integrate into the new development
         paradigm, and strictly adhere to the overall goals, principles, and requirements for state-
         owned central enterprises in the new era and on the new journey. Focusing on the primary
         task of high-quality development and aligning with the requirements for developing new
         quality productive forces, the Company will comprehensively implement the “1256" medium-
         and long-term development strategy:

         Anchored on “One Vision”: To develop into a world-class modern enterprise;

         Focus on “Two Major Directions”: Consolidate and upgrade the traditional construction
         industry, and cultivate and expand strategic emerging industries;

         Open up “five new tracks”: New infrastructure, new equipment, new materials, new energy,
         and new services;

         Accelerate the “six transformations”: High-end, intelligent, green, digital, refined, and
         international transformation.

                       2.     Operation plan for 2026

                (IV)   Potential risks

                        ✓ Applicable              Not Applicable

                       By further advancing the “internal risk control system”, the Group has continuously
                       strengthened the application of Cloud Risk Control Monitoring Centre, and actively trouble
                       -shot and controlled major and especially significant risks. Through conducting annual
                       significant risk assessments and comprehensively evaluating the internal and external
                       environment as well as the actual operations and management of the enterprise, the
                       Group has identified the following as the major risks it may face: market competition risk,
                       international operations and management risks, debt and funding risk, safety risk, and
                       project management risk.

                       1.     Market competition risks

                              Affected by market structural adjustments and the reshaping of the competitive
                              landscape, the industry as a whole exhibits characteristics of “stock competition”.
                              Both existing and potential competitors continue to optimize their market presence,
                              leading to increasingly intense competition. Significant adverse changes in market
                              conditions or fluctuations in the Company’s market share could have a certain impact
                              on the Company’s operating performance. The Group closely monitors developments
                              in the industry and market conditions, dynamically assesses the trends of existing and
                              potential competitors, continuously benchmarks and analyzes its own strengths and
                              weaknesses, and enhances its mechanisms for monitoring, analyzing, and providing
                              early warnings regarding market competition risks. Centered on the objective of “high-
                              quality operations”, the Group aims to consolidate its core markets, expand into
                              potential regions, focus on improving the quality of its operational work, enhance its
                              ability to withstand market risks, and build a secure foundation for the high-quality
                              development of the enterprise.
                                                                                                   79




      Section IV Management Discussion and Analysis
     (Work Report of the Board of Directors) (continued)


2.    International operation and management risks

      The global political and economic landscape is complex and volatile. Geopolitical
      conflicts persist in certain regions amid ongoing instability, while major power rivalries
      intensify. Unilateral trade protectionism has impacted the multilateral trading system.
      The Company faces a series of risks and challenges in expanding its overseas
      business, project financing, contract performance, tax planning and compliance, as
      well as ensuring the safety and security of overseas employees. The Group adheres
      to the strategy of prioritizing overseas development, continuously optimizes its
      overseas business management system, focuses on core pillar markets, implements
      precise “one country, one policy” layouts, and enhances the synergistic development
      effectiveness in overseas markets. The Group strengthens whole-cycle project
      control, strictly manages pre-bid reviews and bidding processes, optimizes resource
      allocation, enhances risk prevention and control in key areas such as commercial,
      contractual, technical, schedule, and tax matters, and improves project refinement
      management levels and operational efficiency. The Group balances development
      and security, improves the mechanism for preventing overseas business risks, strictly
      adheres to principles for overseas market entry, strengthens the identification of risks
      at the source, and strictly complies with overseas compliance requirements. The
      Group improves its overseas security assurance system, strengthens safety education,
      training, and emergency drills for expatriate personnel, and establishes a robust
      country-specific risk joint prevention and control mechanism, effectively safeguarding
      the safety of personnel and assets abroad.

3.    Debt and funding risks

      Affected by multiple factors such as fiscal constraints of local governments, the
      Company’s liquidity pressure has continued to increase. In order to effectively prevent
      and control financial risks, the Company has strengthened strategic cooperation
      with financial institutions, establishing credit cooperation relationships with over
      40 domestic and foreign banks, including large state-owned commercial banks, to
      ensure the effective completion of the Company’s financing plans. The Company
      implements strict budgetary control over all interest-bearing debts and exercises tight
      control over public bond issuance, factoring, and asset securitization activities. The
      Company strengthens accounts receivable collection and overdue debt management,
      establishing a comprehensive, full-cycle dynamic control mechanism. It clarifies
      project collection targets, detailed recovery plans, and intensifies performance
      assessments, while also enhancing process supervision through on-site investigations,
      special meetings, and collective interviews. Responsibilities for receivables collection
      are strictly enforced to ensure that debt recovery efforts are effectively implemented.
      The Company seizes the window of declining market interest rates, actively strives
      for policy-based funds such as national interest subsidies and ultra-long-term special
      government bonds, promotes financing replacement efforts, and further reduces the
      average financing cost.
80   China Railway Construction Corporation Limited∣Annual Report 2025




       Section IV Management Discussion and Analysis
       (Work Report of the Board of Directors) (continued)


                       4.     Security risks

                              Some projects in the infrastructure industry involve high construction difficulty and
                              significant environmental risks, making the safety production situation severe and
                              complex and posing substantial pressure on safety management and control. To
                              effectively prevent safety risks, the Group has earnestly carried out fundamental safety
                              production improvement initiatives, focusing on enhancing management efficiency,
                              strengthening the role of technology in empowering safety production, fully utilizing
                              modern information technology and methods, enhancing intelligent construction safety
                              management, and improving inherent safety levels. The Group has strengthened
                              end-to-end safety governance, establishing and improving a comprehensive safety
                              management system that spans from corporate-level safety governance, project safety
                              management, and subcontractor safety oversight to work-team management.

                       5.     Project management risks

                              As affected by various factors such as the intensified industry competition,
                              uncertainties in the project management process continue to increase. To prevent and
                              control risks, the Group continuously strengthens refined management, deeply carries
                              out the “Comprehensive Deepening Year” action for refined management, issues
                              refined management operational guidance manuals for different sectors, reports on
                              the completion status of key refined management task lists quarterly, and conducts
                              “Four Noes and Two Directs” refined management supervision to urge all units to
                              strictly implement the Group’s refined management guidance and supporting systems
                              and measures. The Group reinforces responsibility cost management, with focused
                              attention on project responsibility budget formulation, responsibility contract signing,
                              secondary breakdown of responsibility budgets, dynamic process cost control and
                              contract performance management, ensures supply chain fund payments, prevents
                              contract litigation risks, strictly implements assessment and incentive mechanisms,
                              and continuously stimulates the internal motivation of project management teams.
                              The Group accelerates the construction and application of the project management
                              system, empowering penetrating management through information technology.
